csv_scope_of_work: The Oklahoma Department of Aerospace & Aeronautics may be seeking a consultant to provide a Design for Enid Woodring Regional Airport Reconstruct Taxiway B. The Overall Development Objective (ODO) of the proposed project is to reconstruct Taxiway B and install LED lights and guidance signs. The pavement on Taxiway B is exhibiting distresses such as block cracking, patching, and weathering. The pavement has deteriorated to the point that reconstruction is required. During the time of taxiway closure and repair, LED lights and guidance signs will be installed.
